# Tehran English Discussion (.TED)

> A free English discussion club in Tehran, Iran, for people whose English is already fluent. Members meet every Friday at Raya House café (خانه رایا), No. 20 Khosrow Alley, near Karim Khan, in two sessions: 4–6 p.m. and 6–8 p.m. Running since March 2025, with 116+ sessions on record.

## Key facts
- Name: Tehran English Discussion, short name .TED
- What: a member-run English conversation and discussion club (not a class: no drills, no exam prep)
- Who: adults with fluent English who enjoy deep conversation about life lessons and big ideas
- When: every Friday, 4–6 p.m. and 6–8 p.m. (Tehran time), each with its own topic and moderator
- Where: Raya House café, No. 20 Khosrow Alley, District 6, near Karim Khan, Tehran
- Cost: free
- How to join: send a short English voice introduction on Telegram to @pjsofts (https://t.me/pjsofts)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/tehran.english.discussion

## Pages
- [Home](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/): what the club is, next Friday, FAQ and how to join
- [Session archive](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/sessions/): every topic and moderator since March 2025
- [Commit or Quit?](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/commit-or-quit/): workshop on commitment (the three-doors game, Kierkegaard’s three ways to live, real vs counterfeit commitment, questions for the table), Friday 27 Nov 2026, 6–8 p.m., with Pouria
- [Who decided that this is beautiful?](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/beauty/): Friday 20 Nov 2026, 4–6 p.m., with Sareh
- [The Golden Whisk](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/golden-whisk/): murder mystery night, Friday 20 Nov 2026, 6–8 p.m., with Bahar
- [How to plan next year in times of war](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/plan-next-year/): workshop questions and workbook

## Online and in Persian
- [Online table](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/online/): free English discussion on Google Meet, every other Monday, 8–10 p.m. Tehran time, up to 12 people, member moderators; past topics and their questions.
- [معرفی به فارسی](https://tehran-english-discussion.github.io/fa/): the club introduced in Persian (باشگاه گفتگوی انگلیسی تهران، دورهمی رایگان گفتگوی آزاد به انگلیسی).
